reviews.title: Be aware!! This is a completely fraud app. That charge you extra
reviews.text:
This app deserves zero star. Be aware they are fraud. I saw an add claiming it’s a walking Ti chi with exercise. In the ad they show you a woman walking and doing Ti Chi exercises. I subscribed for 3 months USD 29.99. Then I received a notification from my bank with extra charges USD 11.99 😳😳 which I didn’t subscribe for. 
I didn’t receive any emails or confirmations of my purchases. It took them a while to send it. With no explanation of the charges. Then I received a lame app with a lame PDF. You can’t link the app to your account or email you registered with. All you get is a lame walking voice that says walking slowly, walking fast , cooling, warm up. Seriously with no videos to show the ti chi exercises.  I contacted the company they respond that they are legit which I doubt and the extra 11.99 USD for fat burner program which I didn’t subscribe from first place. I asked again for refund they told me it’s non refundable!!!!
Trust me they are a fraud . How come they charge me extra , refuse to refund and it’s not what they claim. Be aware don’t buy products don’t trust them.

reviews.title: Paid and Received  Nothing
reviews.text:
Do Not Pay For Anything On This App. I signed up and paid $19.99 for a
Premium subscription for 4 weeks through an ad. When I downloaded the App and set up my account and signed in, I had no subscription and would have to pay 19.99 AGAIN if I wanted a subscription. Also, I was charged an additional $11.99. I was told by customer service that it was for the “fat burning addition”. I did not sign up for that. I still do not have access to any of it. I was told there are no refunds. I paid and received nothing for it. What a rip off. 

You cannot call and talk to anyone. It is all done by email and you cannot correspond with the same person. So, when you need to reply with additional info or questions, you have to start all over again. They have not helped me get my services and they claim they have canceled it when my 4 weeks is up. We will see. 

I have filed a dispute with my credit card to try to get my money back. I would give this zero stars if I could.

reviews.title: Not an easy app for me
reviews.text:
I purchased this app yesterday. I paid 19.99 and downloaded the app from the email they sent me. I set everything up yet it would not allow me to proceed to do any workouts unless I paid an additional weekly fee for all purpose access, so I asked them to cancelled it. Customer service said they cancelled it and wanted to know why. 
So I sent a screenshot of the page that required a weekly fee but have not heard back. Although they said they cancelled my program, I was just for charged an additional 11.99 on my card. 
This seems to be a misleading program.
